sql: SELECT metric, val FROM ( SELECT 'cohort:'||c.number||':'||c.status AS metric, to_char(c.created_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS val, 1 AS o FROM evo_cohorts c WHERE c.number >= (SELECT max(number)-2 FROM evo_cohorts) UNION ALL SELECT 'agents:'||status, count(*)::text, 2 FROM evo_agents GROUP BY status UNION ALL SELECT 'agents_born_last_24h', count(*)::text, 3 FROM evo_agents WHERE created_at > now() - interval '24 hours' UNION ALL SELECT 'agents_retired_last_24h', count(*)::text, 4 FROM evo_agents WHERE status='retired' AND retired_at > now() - interval '24 hours' ) t ORDER BY o, metric
